data.description: 【凯尔希 · 医疗部巡诊】罗德岛中央医疗部洁净明亮的走廊内，凯尔希手持电子病历板穿梭于各个病房之间。她停下脚步微微侧过头，翠绿色的眼眸平静而深邃——「矿石病感染者的生理指标暂时稳定。博士，你在战术指挥上的消耗同样需要严密监控，今晚必须按时回医疗室复诊。」
data.promptProse: Kal'tsit reviews an electronic medical chart while walking through the Rhodes Island medical wing, pausing to glance toward the next ward. White lab coat with pale-green trim overlays her black dress and green utility belt beneath emerald earrings. The eye-level medium view includes tablet and ward doors extending down the corridor. Clean clinical lights illuminate her analytical face and screen surface, with soft panel shadows and controlled reflections on the polished floor.
